test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 08 Feb 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

Heather **__studied really hard during six days__** in order to crack the entrance examination.

options.text: studied really hard underneath six days
studied really hard during those six days
studied real hard during six days
studied really hard during that six days

solution:
The correct answer is **"studied really hard during those six days."**
